intervals.label: collaboration: proposed to the J-PARC programme advisory committee
intervals.quote: The experiment was proposed to the J-PARC program advisory committee in 2009.

intervals.label: collaboration: approved (stage-2) and under construction
intervals.note: Stage-2 approval by KEK in 2019 (conceptual design report 2012, technical design report 2015, review 2016). The J-PARC release of August 2026 reports that the H2 experimental area was completed in FY2024 and in operation since FY2025, and that cooled muons were accelerated to 0.3 MeV there in June 2026 (target: 4 MeV around 2027-28).
intervals.quote: With positive recommendations from the review committee and PAC, the experiment received the stage-2 status, a final stage of approval, from KEK in 2019.

intervals.label: collaboration: start of the measurement (planned, late 2020s)
intervals.note: Schedule, not an event; the collaboration's own wording is "the late 2020s".
intervals.quote: The international collaboration has been preparing for the experiment aiming to start the experiment in the late 2020s.

summary.plain: The international team of scientists who run the J-PARC muon g-2/EDM (E34) experiment.
